people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: These are those who were counted of the children of Israel by their fathers’ houses. All who were counted of the camps according to their armies were six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.
translations.bsb: These are the Israelites, numbered according to their families. The total of those counted in the camps, by their divisions, was 603,550.
translations.kjv: These are those which were numbered of the children of Israel by the house of their fathers: all those that were numbered of the camps throughout their hosts were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.
translations.asv: These are they that were numbered of the children of Israel by their fathers' houses: all that were numbered of the camps according to their hosts were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.
